definitions.explanation: The month before this one; the previous month. Used to refer to events or states in the month that just passed.

examples.japanese: {先月|せんげつ}{新|あたら}しい{車|くるま}を{買|か}いました。
examples.english: I bought a new car last month.

examples.japanese: {先月|せんげつ}{友達|ともだち}に{会|あ}いました。
examples.english: I met my friend last month.

examples.japanese: {先月|せんげつ}は{忙|いそが}しかったです。{毎日|まいにち}{仕事|しごと}がありました。
examples.english: I was busy last month. I had work every day.

examples.japanese: {先月|せんげつ}{母|はは}が{日本|にほん}に{来|き}ましたが、もう{帰|かえ}りました。
examples.english: My mother came to Japan last month, but she already went back.

examples.japanese: {先月|せんげつ}は{毎日|まいにち}{雨|あめ}が{降|ふ}りました。{今月|こんげつ}は{天気|てんき}がいいから、うれしいです。
examples.english: It rained every day last month. The weather is good this month, so I'm happy.

notes:
{先月|せんげつ} means 'last month' and is part of the time reference system.

TIME SERIES - MONTHS:
- {先々月|せんせんげつ}: the month before last
- {先月|せんげつ}: last month
- {今月|こんげつ}: this month
- {来月|らいげつ}: next month
- {再来月|さらいげつ}: the month after next

KANJI BREAKDOWN:
- {先|せん}: previous, before
- {月|げつ}: month

SIMILAR WORDS WITH {先|せん}:
- {先週|せんしゅう}: last week
- {先日|せんじつ}: the other day
- {先年|せんねん}: years ago, previous years

GRAMMAR NOTES:
- Used as time adverb without particle: {先月|せんげつ}{行|い}った (I went last month)
- Used as noun with の: {先月|せんげつ}の{売|う}り{上|あ}げ (last month's sales)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {先月|せんげつ}の{末|まつ}: end of last month
- {先月|せんげつ}の{初|はじ}め: beginning of last month
